text:
maria: Hey all — proposal: add a tiny client-side probe that fires on request completion to capture per-route canary signals (latency, status, routing_decision, quota_bucket). Goal is to give the rollout compare page higher-fidelity split-level metrics without doubling ingest from server-side logs.

kevin: curious — is this for all traffic or sampled? data volume could blow up. :eyes:

maria: sampling by default. 1% global, configurable per-customer or per-route. we want deterministic sampling keys so comparisons between canary/control are unbiased.

sasha: make sure probe payloads contain the route_id and rollout_tag (canary_id) and the kvcache_hit boolean. also we need model_variant label.

priya: from console UX side we need per-route p50/p90/p99 and error_ratio, plus event counts and sample sizes. low sample size should surface as a warning.

oliver: SRE: ingestion cost + PII — probes must be tiny and only send labels, no prompt text or tokens. also rate-limit them server-side.

maria: agreed — payload example: ```json
{ "route_id":"r123", "rollout":"canary-A", "variant":"v2-q4", "lat_ms":123, "status":200, "quota_bucket":"q_beta", "kvcache":false }
```

kevin: naming/metrics question — do we send a raw event stream and compute histograms in the analytics pipeline or pre-bucket on the client?

yuki: prefer server-side histogramming to avoid clock skew issues and keep client simple. client sends one compact event per request. pipeline aggregates into per-route histograms and exposes them as prometheus timeseries and rollup tables for the dashboard.

sasha: need to land schema so infra can validate. proposed fields: route_id, rollout_tag, variant_id, latency_ms, status_class, sample_seed, cache_hit, quota_bucket, region. All strings except latency_ms and sample_seed.

priya: can we include an optional attribution field so product can map feature flags to rollouts? small string only.

oliver: retention policy: keep raw events 7 days, aggregated rollup 90 days. anything longer is expensive. Cost team OK?

kevin: cost team flagged 90d rollups as OK if we downsample per-hour after 7 days. add an opt-in 365d for enterprise under contract.

maria: UX asks: the rollout compare UI should show side-by-side histograms, relative delta, and a sigma-based regression flag. It should also list sample counts and an indicator when underpowered.

priya: can we add a small 'quick check' panel that shows probe health (send rate, % dropped by quota, avg latency) so we know the probe itself isn't skewing results.

yuki: infra work: need a lightweight ingestion endpoint behind our edge with HMAC auth (probe key per-customer), throttling, and a transform service that stamps server_ts and joins routing metadata. I'll own the endpoint but need schema finalization.

maria: action items: 1) schema PR (sasha) 2) ingestion endpoint + auth (yuki) 3) dashboard panels + regression rule (priya + kevin) 4) sampling config + rollout tagging (maria) 5) cost/retention signoff (oliver).

sasha: I'll open the schema PR today with examples and a small JSON schema.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: schema-validation-lambda v2 -> staging at 2026-04-01T02:00Z :rocket:

kevin: quick note on alerts: tie regression flags to canary-specific thresholds and automatically mute noisy signals for low-sample routes.

priya: agreed, plus add a link from the regression alert to a 'why' box explaining possible confounders (sample size, region skew, cache warmup).

maria: perfect. last thing — we should run a 2-week shadow run (no dashboards yet) to measure overhead before enabling UI. who wants to join the SOC for that?

oliver: SRE will monitor during shadow run; sending calendar invite.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll summarize in a follow-up doc and ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
